name: How often should I do cardio endurance training to see results?
description: Aim for 3-5 cardio endurance sessions per week, each 20-60 minutes, to see results. Beginners can start with 2-3 sessions and gradually increase frequency.

mainEntity.name: How often should I do cardio endurance training to see results?

acceptedAnswer.text: The frequency of cardio endurance training depends on your current fitness level and goals, but generally, 3-5 sessions per week are recommended for significant results. Each session should ideally be 20-60 minutes long. For beginners at Cave Training, we recommend starting with 2-3 sessions to build a foundation and then gradually increasing frequency and intensity as your stamina improves. Consistency is key, so prioritizing regular sessions over sporadic, intense ones will yield better long-term outcomes.
